info.title: E-Commerce Order & Promotion API
info.description:
REST API for browsing products, managing a cart, applying promotional codes, checking out and managing orders.

**Money** is returned as decimal strings (e.g. `"149.99"`) and accepted in dollars; it is stored as integer cents.

**Errors** share one shape: `{ "message", "code", "details"? }`. Validation errors (`validation_failed`) add an `errors` object keyed by field.

**Authentication**: call `POST /api/auth/login` (or register), then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

get.description: All products, including inactive ones, newest first.

patch.description: Also available as PUT. Send only the fields to change. Products are not deleted; set status to inactive instead.

delete.description: Past orders keep their promotion_code snapshot; carts using the code simply lose it.

204.description: Deleted. Past orders keep the code they used.

patch.description: Also available as PUT. Send only the fields to change; times_used cannot be set.

post.summary: Register a customer and get a token
post.description: Rate limited to 5 requests per minute per IP.

post.summary: Log in and get a token
post.description: Rate limited to 5 attempts per minute per email and IP. Demo accounts (local seed data): customer@example.com and admin@example.com, password "password".

422.description: Invalid input, or the credentials do not match (same message for an unknown email and a wrong password).

example.message: These credentials do not match our records.

email: These credentials do not match our records.

post.description: Revoke only the token used for this request; other devices stay signed in.

204.description: Token revoked; other tokens stay valid.

get.description: Read-only: a customer without a cart gets an empty one. The applied promotion is re-evaluated; if it is no longer valid it is reported with its reason and not discounted.

200.description: The cart priced at current product prices.

post.summary: Add a product to the cart
post.description: Adding a product that is already in the cart increases its quantity. Stock is checked but not reserved.

422.description: Invalid input (`validation_failed`, e.g. an inactive or unknown product), or the quantity in the cart would exceed the available stock (`insufficient_stock`).

value.message: Only 3 units of 'Desk Lamp' are available.
The quantity field must be at least 1.

quantity: The quantity field must be at least 1.

patch.description: Also available as PUT. Items belonging to other customers return 404 (`cart_item_not_found`).

422.description: Invalid quantity (`validation_failed`) or more than the available stock (`insufficient_stock`).

value.message: Only 3 units of 'Desk Lamp' are available.
The quantity field must be at least 1.

quantity: The quantity field must be at least 1.

post.description: Codes are matched ignoring case and surrounding spaces. Eligibility is checked again at checkout.

200.description: The cart with the discount applied.

422.description: The customer is not eligible: `coupon_invalid` (unknown, inactive or not started), `coupon_expired`, `coupon_usage_limit_reached`, `coupon_customer_limit_reached`, `coupon_minimum_not_met`; or `cart_empty`; or `validation_failed`.

value.message: This coupon has reached its usage limit.
You have already used this coupon the maximum number of times.
This coupon requires a minimum cart subtotal of 100.00.

post.summary: Place an order from the cart
post.description: Takes no body: prices and totals are recalculated on the server from the locked product rows, and anything sent by the client is ignored. Runs in one database transaction with row locks, so concurrent checkouts can never oversell stock or a coupon. Send an Idempotency-Key header to make retries safe.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional, up to 100 characters (letters, numbers, - _ : .). Retrying with the same key returns the original order with status 200.

200.description: Replay of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key; nothing new was placed.

422.description: Nothing was changed: `cart_empty`, `insufficient_stock` (lists every short item), a coupon error (`coupon_*`), or an invalid Idempotency-Key (`validation_failed`).

value.message: Only 3 units of 'Desk Lamp' are available.

get.description: The customer's own orders, newest first.
Orders belonging to other customers return 403 (`forbidden`).

post.description: Allowed while pending or processing. Restores the purchased stock and gives back the coupon use. Safe to send more than once: stock is restored exactly once.

200.description: The cancelled order. Repeating the request returns 200 and changes nothing.

409.description: The order has shipped or been delivered (`invalid_order_status`).

example.message: Orders that are shipped can no longer be cancelled.

get.description: Filtering and sorting use the spatie/laravel-query-builder syntax. Unknown filters or sorts return 422. Results are cached per filter combination and refreshed whenever a product or its stock changes.

parameters.name: filter[name]
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial name match; %, _ and commas are matched literally.

parameters.name: filter[max_price]
parameters.description: Maximum price in dollars (inclusive); must be at least min_price.

parameters.name: filter[in_stock]
parameters.description: true: stock above 0; false: out of stock.

get.description: Inactive products return 404 like missing ones.

message.example: Only 3 units of 'Desk Lamp' are available.
The quantity field must be at least 1.

quantity: The quantity field must be at least 1.

available_quantity.description: Units that can be bought now (0 if the product was deactivated).

is_available.description: False when stock dropped below the quantity or the product was deactivated.

promotion.description: The applied code, re-evaluated on every read. An invalid code is reported and not discounted.

OrderItem.description: Snapshot taken at purchase time; later product changes do not affect it.

product_id.description: Null if the product was later deleted.

value.description: Whole percent (integer) for percentage codes; dollar amount (string) for fixed codes.

ProductInput.description: All fields required on create (POST); any subset on update (PATCH/PUT).

sku.description: Unique; letters, numbers, dots, dashes, underscores.

PromotionInput.description: code, type and value are required on create (POST); any subset on update (PATCH/PUT). Changing `type` requires a new `value`.

value.description: Whole percent 1–100, or a dollar amount for fixed codes.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not allowed (`forbidden`), e.g. another customer's order or a non-admin on an admin route.

example.message: You do not have access to this order.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded (`too_many_requests`); see the `Retry-After` header.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until another request is allowed.

sanctum.description: Sanctum personal access token from /api/auth/login or /api/auth/register.
